source_extracts.label: Amazon Prime Air expansion announcement
source_extracts.quote: Amazon Prime Air plans to serve nearly 500 cities and towns by the end of 2026 — a sixfold increase from its current footprint — with Cleveland, Ohio on the launch list. "We've already delivered hundreds of thousands of packages to customers by drone this year." Items arrive in as fast as 30 minutes, with most deliveries landing around an hour after the order. (verified 2026-11-20)

source_extracts.label: Amazon Prime Air operating rules
source_extracts.quote: Drones carry items weighing 5 pounds or less that fit in a large shoebox. Drone delivery is not available at night, during heavy winds, or in unfavorable weather (per Amazon). (verified 2026-11-20)

source_extracts.label: site pricing pages
source_extracts.quote: Personal tiers $15 (Small Mail-Only) and $25 (Small +10 Packages) per month; month-to-month, no term commitment.
